description: Android accessibility fix cases: concrete bad-code to good-code examples for RAG repair.

source.title_zh: Compose 开关设置项重复焦点

content.summary_en: A settings row and its Switch both handle clicks, creating duplicate TalkBack focus stops for one setting.
content.summary_zh: 设置项 Row 和内部 Switch 同时可点击，导致 TalkBack 对同一个设置出现重复焦点。
content.intent_en: Expose the whole row as one switch control while keeping the visual Switch from adding a second action.
content.intent_zh: 把整行暴露为一个开关控件，同时避免视觉 Switch 再创建第二个操作焦点。
requirements_en: Use Modifier.toggleable on the row with role = Role.Switch.
Set the child Switch onCheckedChange to null when the parent row owns the action.
Keep visible label text inside the same semantic control.
Only add stateDescription when default state wording is insufficient.
requirements_zh: 在整行 Row 上使用 Modifier.toggleable，并设置 role = Role.Switch。
父行处理切换时，将子 Switch 的 onCheckedChange 设置为 null。
可见标签文本应处于同一个语义控件中。
默认状态播报不足时，再补充 stateDescription。

good_examples.code:
Row(
    modifier = Modifier
        .fillMaxWidth()
        .toggleable(
            value = checked,
            role = Role.Switch,
            onValueChange = onCheckedChange
        )
        .padding(16.dp),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
) {
    Text(text = title, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
    Switch(checked = checked, onCheckedChange = null)
}
good_examples.explanation_en: The row is the only semantic switch action, and the child Switch is visual.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 整行是唯一的语义开关操作，子 Switch 只负责视觉呈现。

bad_examples.title_zh: Row 和 Switch 都可点击
bad_examples.explanation_en: The same setting may be exposed twice to TalkBack and Switch Access.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 同一个设置可能被 TalkBack 和 Switch Access 识别成两个焦点。

repair_suggestions_en: Move the toggle action to the parent row with toggleable.
Make the child Switch passive by setting onCheckedChange = null.
Verify TalkBack announces one name, one role, and one state.
repair_suggestions_zh: 把切换操作移动到父 Row 的 toggleable 上。
将子 Switch 设为被动视觉控件：onCheckedChange = null。
用 TalkBack 验证只播报一个名称、一个角色和一个状态。
manual_checks_en: Swipe through the setting with TalkBack; it should stop once.
Toggle it and verify the new state is announced.
manual_checks_zh: 用 TalkBack 滑到该设置项，应只停留一次。
切换后确认新状态会被播报。

source.title_zh: RecyclerView 重复更多按钮标签

content.summary_en: Repeated overflow buttons in a RecyclerView use the same generic contentDescription, so users cannot tell which item the menu belongs to.
content.summary_zh: RecyclerView 中重复的更多按钮使用同一个通用 contentDescription，用户无法判断菜单属于哪个条目。
content.intent_en: Bind item-specific labels every time a recycled item view is bound.
content.intent_zh: 每次绑定复用条目时，都用当前条目数据生成具体标签。
requirements_en: Include the item title or stable identifier in repeated action labels.
Set contentDescription during every ViewHolder bind.
Do not leave stale contentDescription values on recycled views.
Use string resources with placeholders for localization.
requirements_zh: 重复操作标签中包含条目标题或稳定标识。
每次 ViewHolder 绑定时都设置 contentDescription。
不要让复用视图保留旧的 contentDescription。
使用带占位符的 string resource 以支持本地化。

good_examples.title_zh: 结合条目的更多菜单标签
good_examples.explanation_en: Each overflow button announces the item it controls.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 每个更多按钮都会播报自己控制的具体条目。

bad_examples.explanation_en: Every row announces the same label.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 每一行都播报相同的“更多”。

repair_suggestions_en: Replace generic labels with item-specific string resources.
Audit all repeated icon buttons in lists.
Scroll the list and verify labels stay aligned with visible data.
repair_suggestions_zh: 用带条目名称的字符串资源替换通用标签。
检查列表中所有重复图标按钮。
滚动列表后确认标签仍与可见数据一致。
manual_checks_en: Use TalkBack on several list items and compare overflow labels.
Scroll far enough to force recycling and test again.
manual_checks_zh: 用 TalkBack 检查多个列表项的更多按钮标签。
滚动到发生视图复用后再次检查。

source.title_zh: Compose 图标按钮缺少标签

content.summary_en: An icon-only Compose button uses contentDescription = null, making its action unnamed for assistive technologies.
content.summary_zh: 只有图标的 Compose 按钮使用 contentDescription = null，导致辅助技术无法获得操作名称。
content.intent_en: Provide a localized accessible name for meaningful icon-only actions, and reserve null descriptions for decorative icons.
content.intent_zh: 为有意义的纯图标操作提供本地化可访问名称，只把 null 描述用于装饰图标。
requirements_en: Icon-only actions need a localized contentDescription.
If the parent has semantics, avoid duplicate child descriptions.
Use contentDescription = null only when the icon is decorative or duplicated by visible text.
requirements_zh: 只有图标的操作必须提供本地化 contentDescription。
父容器已有语义时，避免子图标重复描述。
只有装饰图标或已被可见文本表达时，才使用 contentDescription = null。

good_examples.explanation_en: The action is named for TalkBack and Voice Access.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 该操作能被 TalkBack 和 Voice Access 正确命名。

bad_examples.explanation_en: The icon is the only visible content but is hidden from accessibility services.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 图标是唯一可见内容，却被无障碍服务忽略。

repair_suggestions_en: Add a stringResource contentDescription to the meaningful icon.
If the button contains visible text, keep the icon decorative.
Check toolbar actions one by one with TalkBack.
repair_suggestions_zh: 为有意义图标添加 stringResource contentDescription。
如果按钮已有可见文本，图标保持装饰即可。
逐个用 TalkBack 检查工具栏操作。
manual_checks_en: Swipe through toolbar actions with TalkBack.
Use Voice Access and verify commands match action labels.
manual_checks_zh: 用 TalkBack 遍历工具栏操作。
使用 Voice Access 检查命令是否匹配操作标签。

source.title_zh: 自定义 View 缺少 performClick

content.summary_en: A custom View handles touch directly but does not override performClick, so accessibility services lack a standard activation path.
content.summary_zh: 自定义 View 直接处理触摸却没有覆盖 performClick，辅助服务缺少标准激活入口。
content.intent_en: Route custom touch activation through performClick and expose the same action to accessibility services.
content.intent_zh: 把自定义触摸激活统一路由到 performClick，并向辅助服务暴露同样的操作。
requirements_en: Override performClick and call super.performClick().
Call performClick from the touch-up activation path.
Ensure keyboard/D-pad activation triggers the same behavior.
Populate accessibility node info if the custom view has custom role or state.
requirements_zh: 覆盖 performClick，并调用 super.performClick()。
在触摸抬起的激活路径中调用 performClick。
确保键盘/方向键激活触发同样行为。
自定义角色或状态时，补充 AccessibilityNodeInfo。

good_examples.explanation_en: The accessibility action and touch action share one activation path.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 无障碍动作和触摸动作共享同一个激活路径。

bad_examples.explanation_en: This can trigger ClickableViewAccessibility lint warnings and block non-touch users.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 这会触发 ClickableViewAccessibility lint 警告，也可能阻碍非触摸用户。

repair_suggestions_en: Add performClick and call it from onTouchEvent.
Handle Enter and D-pad center consistently.
Run lint after the repair.
repair_suggestions_zh: 补充 performClick，并从 onTouchEvent 调用。
一致处理 Enter 和方向键中键。
修复后运行 lint。
manual_checks_en: Run Android Lint and verify the warning is gone.
Activate the view with TalkBack and keyboard.
manual_checks_zh: 运行 Android Lint，确认警告消失。
使用 TalkBack 和键盘激活该 View。

source.title_zh: 滑动操作缺少替代方式

content.summary_en: A list item can only be deleted or dismissed with a swipe gesture, leaving keyboard, TalkBack, and Switch Access users without an equivalent action.
content.summary_zh: 列表项只能通过滑动删除或关闭，键盘、TalkBack 和 Switch Access 用户缺少等价操作。
content.intent_en: Provide visible buttons or custom accessibility actions for gesture-only behavior.
content.intent_zh: 为仅手势行为提供可见按钮或自定义无障碍操作。
requirements_en: Gesture-only operations need a selectable alternative.
Destructive alternatives must have item-specific labels.
For Compose, consider customActions only when visible buttons would duplicate an already clear action.
Ensure Switch Access can discover the action.
requirements_zh: 仅手势操作必须提供可选择的替代方式。
破坏性替代操作必须包含条目上下文。
Compose 中只有在可见按钮会造成明显重复时才考虑 customActions。
确保 Switch Access 能发现该操作。

good_examples.explanation_en: Delete is available through a normal selectable control.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 删除操作可通过普通可选择控件完成。

bad_examples.explanation_en: Users who cannot swipe may not be able to delete the item.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 不能滑动的用户可能无法删除该条目。

repair_suggestions_en: Add an item-specific visible delete/dismiss button.
Add customActions only after testing with TalkBack.
Verify Switch Access highlights the alternative action.
repair_suggestions_zh: 添加包含条目名称的可见删除/关闭按钮。
仅在 TalkBack 测试后再考虑 customActions。
验证 Switch Access 能高亮替代操作。
manual_checks_en: Complete the action without touch gestures.
Use Switch Access to discover and activate the alternative.
manual_checks_zh: 不使用触摸手势完成该操作。
使用 Switch Access 发现并激活替代操作。

source.title_zh: 输入框只用占位提示当标签

content.summary_en: A field uses placeholder text as its only label, so the field purpose may disappear visually and become unclear after input starts.
content.summary_zh: 输入框只使用 placeholder 作为标签，用户开始输入后字段目的可能消失或变得不清楚。
content.intent_en: Provide a stable label and reserve placeholder/hint text for examples or input format guidance.
content.intent_zh: 提供稳定标签，把 placeholder/hint 留给示例或输入格式说明。
requirements_en: Compose TextField should use label for stable field identity.
Placeholder should show example input, not replace the label.
Invalid fields should expose isError and nearby supportingText.
View EditText should use android:hint and labelFor when a separate label is present.
requirements_zh: Compose TextField 使用 label 表达稳定字段名称。
placeholder 用于示例输入，不替代标签。
无效字段应暴露 isError 和邻近 supportingText。
View/EditText 在有独立标签时使用 labelFor 关联。

good_examples.title_zh: 稳定标签和示例占位提示
good_examples.code:
OutlinedTextField(
    value = email,
    onValueChange = onEmailChange,
    label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.email)) },
    placeholder = { Text("name@example.com") },
    isError = emailError != null,
    supportingText = { emailError?.let { Text(it) } }
)
good_examples.explanation_en: The field has stable identity, example input, and error support.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 字段有稳定名称、示例输入和错误支持。

bad_examples.title_zh: 只有 placeholder 的输入框
bad_examples.explanation_en: The visible label disappears once the field has a value.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 字段有值后，可见标签会消失。

repair_suggestions_en: Move field identity into label.
Use placeholder for examples such as name@example.com.
Add isError and supportingText for validation failures.
repair_suggestions_zh: 把字段名称放入 label。
placeholder 用于 name@example.com 这样的示例。
校验失败时补充 isError 和 supportingText。
manual_checks_en: Enter text and verify the field purpose remains clear.
Use TalkBack to hear label, value, and error.
manual_checks_zh: 输入文本后确认字段目的仍然清楚。
用 TalkBack 听取标签、值和错误。

source.title_zh: 弹窗打开后焦点未进入

content.summary_en: A custom overlay appears visually, but accessibility focus remains behind it and the surface has no title or close semantics.
content.summary_zh: 自定义遮罩视觉上出现了，但无障碍焦点仍停留在背景，弹层也缺少标题或关闭语义。
content.intent_en: Use platform modal components or provide title, pane semantics, initial focus, and focus return.
content.intent_zh: 使用平台模态组件，或补充标题、窗格语义、初始焦点和焦点返回。
requirements_en: Prefer AlertDialog/Dialog/ModalBottomSheet over custom overlays.
Expose a visible title as the dialog or pane title.
Move focus to the title or first useful control when opened.
Restore focus to the trigger when dismissed.
requirements_zh: 优先使用 AlertDialog/Dialog/ModalBottomSheet，而不是自定义遮罩。
把可见标题暴露为对话框或窗格标题。
打开时把焦点移动到标题或第一个有用控件。
关闭后把焦点恢复到触发控件。

good_examples.code:
AlertDialog(
    onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
    title = { Text(stringResource(R.string.confirm_delete)) },
    text = { Text(stringResource(R.string.delete_message)) },
    confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = onConfirm) { Text(stringResource(R.string.delete)) } },
    dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = onDismiss) { Text(stringResource(R.string.cancel)) } }
)
good_examples.explanation_en: The platform component provides modal semantics and named actions.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 平台组件提供模态语义和命名操作。

bad_examples.explanation_en: The overlay has no modal role, no title semantics, and unclear actions.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 遮罩没有模态角色、标题语义和清晰操作。

repair_suggestions_en: Replace custom overlay with AlertDialog or ModalBottomSheet.
Add a named close/cancel action.
Test focus entry and return with TalkBack.
repair_suggestions_zh: 用 AlertDialog 或 ModalBottomSheet 替换自定义遮罩。
增加有名称的关闭/取消操作。
用 TalkBack 测试焦点进入和返回。
manual_checks_en: Open the dialog with TalkBack and check the first announcement.
Dismiss it and confirm focus returns to the trigger.
manual_checks_zh: 用 TalkBack 打开弹窗，检查首次播报。
关闭后确认焦点回到触发控件。

content.summary_en: Search results, loading completion, save success, or validation errors update visually but are not announced to assistive technologies.
content.summary_zh: 搜索结果、加载完成、保存成功或校验错误只在视觉上更新，没有向辅助技术播报。
content.intent_en: Expose important non-focus-moving updates as status messages or polite live regions.
content.intent_zh: 把重要但不移动焦点的更新暴露为状态消息或礼貌实时区域。
requirements_en: Use liveRegion for important Compose text updates that should be announced.
Do not move focus for every incremental result update.
Announce blocking validation errors by moving focus to summary or first invalid field.
Ensure Snackbar actions have accessible names.
requirements_zh: Compose 中重要文本更新使用 liveRegion。
不要为每次增量结果更新移动焦点。
阻塞性校验错误应移动焦点到错误摘要或第一个无效字段。
Snackbar 操作必须有可访问名称。

good_examples.explanation_en: Result changes are announced without stealing focus.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 结果变化会被播报，但不会抢走焦点。

bad_examples.explanation_en: The list changes, but screen reader users receive no status.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 列表改变了，但读屏用户得不到状态反馈。

repair_suggestions_en: Add a visible status Text with liveRegion = Polite.
Use assertive announcements only for urgent errors.
Keep focus stable for non-blocking updates.
repair_suggestions_zh: 增加可见状态文本，并设置 liveRegion = Polite。
仅紧急错误使用更强播报。
非阻塞更新保持焦点稳定。
manual_checks_en: Change results with TalkBack on and listen for count updates.
Verify focus stays in the search field during typing.
manual_checks_zh: 开启 TalkBack 改变结果，听取数量更新。
确认输入搜索时焦点仍留在搜索框。

source.title_en: Android XML Email Field Missing Input Type
source.title_zh: Android XML 邮箱输入框缺少输入类型

content.summary_en: When stable XML evidence identifies a text field as an email-address field and no inputType is declared, set android:inputType to textEmailAddress so Android can expose the intended input purpose and show an appropriate IME.
content.summary_zh: 当 XML 中有稳定证据表明字段用于输入邮箱地址且尚未声明 inputType 时，设置 android:inputType="textEmailAddress"，使 Android 暴露正确输入目的并显示合适键盘。
content.intent_en: Repair a missing email input semantic with one bounded XML attribute edit without changing labels, hierarchy, ids, or validation behavior.
content.intent_zh: 通过一个受限 XML 属性修改补充邮箱输入语义，不改变标签、层级、id 或校验逻辑。
requirements_en: Promote this repair only when an id, label, TextInputLayout hint, or equivalent stable XML evidence identifies an email-address field.
When inputType is absent, set android:inputType="textEmailAddress" on the EditText or TextInputEditText.
Do not confuse an email address with an email subject, message body, username, or generic text field.
inputType does not replace a descriptive label or hint; preserve the existing TextInputLayout or labelFor relationship.
If an existing inputType contains conflicting class or variation flags, require review instead of overwriting it blindly.
requirements_zh: 只有 id、标签、TextInputLayout hint 或等价稳定 XML 证据明确表示邮箱地址字段时才自动修复。
inputType 缺失时，在 EditText 或 TextInputEditText 上设置 android:inputType="textEmailAddress"。
不要把邮件主题、邮件正文、用户名或普通文本字段误判成邮箱地址。
inputType 不能替代描述性标签或 hint；保留已有 TextInputLayout 或 labelFor 关系。
已有 inputType 包含冲突类型或变体时应转人工复核，不要盲目覆盖。

good_examples.title_en: Email field with label and input purpose
good_examples.title_zh: 同时具有标签和邮箱输入语义
good_examples.code:
<com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:hint="@string/email">
    <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
        android:id="@+id/edt_email"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:inputType="textEmailAddress" />
</com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout>
good_examples.explanation_en: The floating label communicates purpose and the inputType communicates email-address input semantics.

content.summary_en: When stable XML evidence identifies a field as a telephone-number field and inputType is absent, set android:inputType to phone so Android exposes phone-number input semantics and an appropriate IME.

requirements_en: Repair only when an id, label, TextInputLayout hint, or equivalent stable XML evidence identifies a telephone-number value.
Set android:inputType="phone" when the attribute is absent.
Do not treat an SMS body, contact name, extension description, generic number, or search field as a telephone-number field.
Do not replace phone with number; phone numbers can contain dialing characters and are not arithmetic values.
Preserve digits, maxLength, country-code guidance, ids, labels, validators, and event handlers.
If existing restrictions conflict with phone input, require review instead of overwriting them.
requirements_zh: 只有 id、标签、TextInputLayout hint 或等价稳定 XML 证据明确表示电话号码值时才修复。

不要用 number 代替 phone；电话号码可能包含拨号字符，并非算术数值。
保留 digits、maxLength、国家区号提示、id、标签、校验器和事件处理。

source.title_en: Android XML Numeric Field Missing Input Type

content.summary_en: When stable XML evidence identifies a field as a numeric value and inputType is absent, choose number or numberDecimal from the field's purpose and preserve any explicit range or character restrictions.
content.summary_zh: 当稳定 XML 证据明确表明字段用于输入数值且 inputType 缺失时，应根据字段用途选择 number 或 numberDecimal，并保留明确的范围或字符限制。
content.intent_en: Expose numeric input semantics without silently changing whether fractions, signs, units, or formatted identifiers are accepted.
content.intent_zh: 补充数值输入语义，同时不擅自改变小数、符号、单位或格式化标识符的接受规则。
requirements_en: Repair only when an id, label, TextInputLayout hint, or equivalent stable XML evidence identifies a specific numeric purpose such as age, count, quantity, amount, price, or measurement.
Use number for integer-only values such as age or count when XML evidence does not allow fractions.
Use numberDecimal only when the purpose or existing restrictions clearly allow fractional values such as amount, price, weight, or measurement.
Add numberSigned only when negative values are explicitly supported; do not infer signed input from a generic number label.
Do not convert phone numbers, postal codes, account identifiers, one-time codes, or free-form formatted values into arithmetic numeric fields.
Preserve digits, maxLength, min/max validation evidence, ids, labels, units, and event handlers; require review when decimal behavior is ambiguous.
requirements_zh: 只有 id、标签、TextInputLayout hint 或等价稳定 XML 证据明确表示年龄、计数、数量、金额、价格或测量值等具体数值用途时才修复。
年龄或计数等仅允许整数的字段使用 number。
只有用途或现有限制明确允许小数时，金额、价格、重量或测量字段才使用 numberDecimal。
只有明确支持负值时才添加 numberSigned，不能根据普通数字标签推断。
不要把电话号码、邮政编码、账户标识、一次性验证码或自由格式值转换为算术数值字段。
保留 digits、maxLength、最小最大值校验证据、id、标签、单位和事件处理；小数行为不明确时转人工复核。

source.title_en: Android XML Format Example Used as the Only Input Label

content.summary_en: A phone number, numeric sample, plus sign, or other format example does not by itself explain an input field's purpose. Keep the example as guidance, but provide a stable purpose label through TextInputLayout, labelFor, or a purpose-specific hint.
content.summary_zh: 电话号码、数字样例、加号等格式示例本身不能说明输入框用途。可以保留示例作为格式指导，但必须通过 TextInputLayout、labelFor 或用途明确的 hint 提供稳定标签。
content.intent_en: Replace an example-only accessible name with a purpose label while preserving useful format guidance and input behavior.
content.intent_zh: 用用途标签替代仅由示例构成的可访问名称，同时保留有用的格式指导和输入行为。
requirements_en: The accessible label must describe what users enter, not only show a syntactically valid example.
Prefer an existing visible TextView with android:labelFor or a TextInputLayout hint when one already represents the field purpose.
A TextView that owns android:labelFor does not need a new android:id; point labelFor to the input's existing id using @id/name, never @+id/name.
When no separate visible label exists, use a concise purpose-specific android:hint and keep format help in nearby helper text when possible.
Do not invent a field purpose from a generic numeric value alone.
Preserve inputType, digits, maxLength, validators, ids, and event handlers.
requirements_zh: 可访问标签必须说明用户要输入什么，不能只展示语法正确的示例。
已有可见 TextView 或 TextInputLayout 表达字段用途时，优先使用 android:labelFor 或父级 hint。
设置 android:labelFor 的 TextView 本身不需要新增 android:id；应使用 @id/name 引用输入框已有 id，不能使用 @+id/name。
没有独立可见标签时，使用简洁且说明用途的 android:hint；可能时把格式示例保留为附近辅助文本。
不要仅根据一个普通数字推断字段用途。
保留 inputType、digits、maxLength、校验器、id 和事件处理。
